result.summary: Several visual and layout issues: truncated restaurant names, a broken discount badge showing '-0%', cut-off category chips, and incomplete card content at the bottom of the feed.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing letters at the end of the card.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on detail view so names are fully readable.

issues.description: Pizza card shows a nonsensical '-0%' badge, which looks like a failed or empty discount label.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when there is no real discount, or show a valid promo (e.g. percentage or 'Deal') only when applicable.

issues.description: Category filter row is clipped on the right; the next chip is only partially visible with no clear affordance to scroll.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll padding/fade or ensure chips wrap/scroll fully so all filters are discoverable.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card is cut off by the tab bar, so image and details are only partially shown.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Delivery time pills on 'Fastest near you' cards sit over the food images and can reduce image clarity.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast (stronger scrim or solid background) or place time below the image for cleaner hierarchy.
